senses.gloss: (v. Harper’s Lat. Dict. s. v. Compromitto) reciprocal promises.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 6:5">Lev. R. s. 6</cite> <he>קופרמסאות נתנו וכ׳</he> (read: <he>קוֹמְפְּרוֹמִיסָאוֹת</he>) they made promises to each other, that he would never disown them, nor they him.
